title: Screen time tasks are unreliable
body: As a whole good, but the Screen time tasks are most of the time not updated, not doing what are in the settings, and you can’t see how much time left…
author: Balázs Cs

title: Habits
body: Based on Atomic Habits book it would be great if the tasks could show the time/location when the task needs to be executed in the corner of the task icon. It could help to make the behavior obvious.
author: tothdani33

title: It’s nice
body:
The app has nice features (love the custom habit icons and the Siri integration), but the UI is not very intuitive. The app fails to explain multiple pages, action buttons, etc, and it’s easy to make mistakes. 
Fortunately it’s possible to edit the data retroactively so it’s an annoyance, not a big issue.
author: jv0521

title: Rengeteg munka van benne
body: Egymillió nagyon szépen kidolgozott ikon van benne amik szabadon felhasználhatók. A program is jó.

title: Szuper
body: Jó az alkalmazás, naprakész (watch app, 3D touch, HealthKit integráció ), motiváló.
author: Ok8316894

title: so-so
body: Very useful app, simple and straight. Easy to customize and make it personal... but definitely overpriced and looks cheap on the Apple Watch and not as comfortable to use than on the iPhone.
author: <<aron]

title: ❤️ Clear & Simple
body: Nice to look at, easy (and a pleasure) to use. The only thing I'd like to see is to have more than 6 things to track. Of course it's to prevent overwhelming you, but productive people might be able to handle. Anyway I can't say a bad word about it.
